{"notes": "Visit 5 (7:45). Nobody spoke while I was there. Table: unchanged from visit 4 as far as I can see. The top line is dark from start through the nose to its tail (x~27, y~5), and the bottom line is dark to its tail (x~27, y~15). Both are connected, with even spacing and smooth curves. The pale stub (x~7.5-9, y~7.5-9) beside the nose is still there and unattached. It looks like a leftover from an abandoned link attempt. It shouldn't affect the push unless it's in the way. The picture shows the result only. I still don't know who placed or fixed what, so I'm giving no individual placement credit from it.

Priya: Her earlier claim that the nose was hooked in was premature, but it's true now. I can't confirm she made the fix. Her testing instinct is good. Ask her what changed and whether she owns the correction.

Tom: Accurate and honest earlier, and he offered help with the joint. The fix plausibly involved him, but I didn't see it. Solid on collaboration and execution, with the fix unconfirmed.

Maya: Silent again. The bottom line is finished, so she probably delivered on pace, but I can't verify who built it. Tentative credit only.

Leo: Five visits with nothing seen or heard. No evidence of impact either way, so I'm not penalizing without information. Ask him privately what he did, and ask the others about him.

Next: Ask each person privately who fixed the nose and who built what. Ask whether anyone plans to remove the stub before the push. Watch for whether the run topples end to end."}
